derivation: FORWARD-ONLY: derived exclusively from inputs (idea, capsule, operator commands, installed manifest, planning facts) and aggregate commands of the TARGET protocol. No reverse-graph material was constructed, read, or searched. No edge is derived from terminal-proof or effect-receipt requirements; terminal/effect nodes appear only as forward continuations of committed source facts.

gaps.title: Physical names not frozen
gaps.detail: This draft proposes the typed command/event/obligation vocabulary semantically. The plan freezes physical names in EK-1; WP-16/EC coordination must pin exact identifiers before WP-05.

gaps.title: Run-level replay-capture sweep placement
gaps.detail: Predecessor evidence shows replay-capture both as a cell-level post-acceptance effect (obligation-contracts effect.replay-capture) and as a lazy engine-exit certification sweep (forward-graph e85). Which target owner settles the run-scope capsule (FactoryRun settlement effect vs a certification Workplace) is not derivable from inputs and commands alone; both readings are represented by one edge to workplace.settleEffect and flagged here.

gaps.title: Watchdog/supervisor target ownership
gaps.detail: Current watchdog/engine-supervisor is host machinery (e82/e83). The target law says watchdogs observe and issue typed commands only. The proposed factoryRun.observeWatchdog aggregate placement needs an EK-1 freeze decision; alternative is a pure observer with no aggregate.

gaps.title: Documentation workshop loop not demonstrated
gaps.detail: Documentation spine is demonstrated 13/23 (conformance-report); repair/crash/fence/idempotency negatives are declared pending. The forward edges here are derived from the universal production-cell loop law plus declared tokens, not from demonstrated drives.

gaps.title: Development pending tokens
gaps.detail: D2 concurrency-cap emergence (structural), D7 stale-readiness-hash (cross-lifecycle), D8 terminal-accounting unknown/human-required, D10 managed continuation/replan drain are lawful in production and unit-proven but not causally demonstrated in the predecessor corpus; edges included from topology + pending declarations with honest status.

gaps.title: Prompt/context admission semantics depth
gaps.detail: admitProviderRequest edges are derived from plan laws only; the predecessor has no equivalent accountant. Exact overflow/repair/retry-charge semantics are EK-1 admission-spec (WP-18) property, not derivable here.

gaps.title: Unknown-to-obligation conservation command
gaps.detail: The plan requires every Discovery unknown to become an open owned obligation that cannot disappear at a workshop boundary. The input side (capsule unknowns) is derivable; the exact target command that opens such an obligation (planner-side workItem.planGraph clause vs a dedicated kernel obligation kind) needs EK-1 freeze. Currently represented inside workItem.planGraph.

gaps.title: Settle node placement
gaps.detail: Current evidence models settle as a per-module kernel node; target grammar maps it to processRun.settle. One EK-1 naming decision; no semantic gap.

gaps.title: Continuation capsule ingress mechanics
gaps.detail: Redevelop/continue currently enter through engine-CLI machinery (capsule-hash-pinned, abandon-shaped parent, package-store copy). Target placement as lifecycleRun.createContinuation + capsule ingress is proposed from operator-command inputs; the D10 continuation token is still pending demonstration.

gaps.title: Effect-uncertainty crash windows demonstrated only partially
gaps.detail: K4:git-effect crash-after-external-mutation-before-receipt and K4:crash-after-effect-before-receipt are declared platform fault edges; the Delivery one is pending. Idempotent-redrive semantics are lawful (obligation-contracts handoff.run-effects) but the crash-window demonstrations are incomplete in the predecessor corpus.
